description: Underwater horizontal visibility affecting observer detection
Sample depth of the survey unit; affects who can be seen and which habitat is sampled
Named protocol including plot size timing and observer rules
notes: RVC detectability includes protocol. Different protocols are different observation processes.

description: Observer-coded habitat on the dive (e.g. HABITAT_CD); describes sampled station not a continuous map
notes: Observed field; not a remote reef layer.

description: Taxon must be on the year-specific published list before a zero can be a survey non-detection
notes: Missing taxon from a year list is not a non-detection for that year.

description: Completed protocol search required before minting SURVEY_NONDETECTION
Primary and secondary sample units or repeats if occupancy-style detection is claimed
Observer identity or team when recorded and rights-cleared
notes: Optional; not a substitute for protocol.

description: Gear-specific catchability distinct from visual census
notes: Do not pool with RVC via source dummy alone.

description: Spatial or taxonomic reporting intensity for presence-only compilers (e.g. OBIS)
notes: Presence compilers have no RVC-style detectability.

description: Temporal factors that change detection or fish availability when recorded
notes: Use only when the source provides them.
